header: Where maintenance teams win back their hours
subheadline: Four places where a service company loses time each day, and what the platform does about each.

items.title: The morning board
items.description: Every open call, technician and deadline on one screen. The board updates in under two seconds, so two dispatchers can use it at once.

items.title: A week without signal
items.description: Vertex Field stores a week of jobs, asset history and forms on the device. Technicians keep working in basements and plant rooms.

items.title: Parts that are really there
items.description: Van stock is counted when each job closes, so the number the dispatcher sees is the number in the van.

items.title: From signature to invoice
items.description: The customer signs on the tablet. The job sheet and parts list reach accounting the same evening.
